user.title: Add a button remote
user.description: Use a Pico from the Lutron Caséta integration, import an existing Pico blueprint automation, or set up a remote from event entities.

menu_options.import_blueprint: Import from a Pico blueprint automation
menu_options.manual: Set up a remote from event entities

import_blueprint.title: Import from a blueprint automation
import_blueprint.description: Pick an automation made with the Lutron Pico Universal Actions blueprint. Its buttons, actions and timing are copied over.

data_description.disable_source: Recommended, so each press doesn't run twice. Nothing is deleted; you can turn it back on anytime.

manual.title: Set up a new remote
manual.description: Pick the event entities for each button. Afterwards, use the edit button next to each button to choose what it does.

data_description.on: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.raise: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.stop: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.lower: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.off: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.button_1: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.button_2: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.button_3: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.button_4: Event entities for this button. Leave empty if the remote doesn't have it.
data_description.press_event_type: The event_type the source entity reports when a button goes down. Lutron uses press.
data_description.release_event_type: The event_type the source entity reports when a button comes up. Lutron uses release.

lutron.title: Lutron Caséta Pico
lutron.description: Pick a Pico from the Lutron Caséta integration. Its buttons are added automatically, and presses are read straight from Lutron, so no other integration is needed.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the Pico's name.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure remote
reconfigure.description: Rename this remote or change the event types its buttons report. To read presses straight from the Lutron Caséta integration instead, pick the Pico below; every button keeps its actions.

data_description.device_id: Optional. Once switched, this remote no longer uses its event entities, so other integrations that provide them are no longer needed for it.
data_description.press_event_type: The event_type the source entity reports when a button goes down. Lutron uses press.
data_description.release_event_type: The event_type the source entity reports when a button comes up. Lutron uses release.

reconfigure_lutron.title: Reconfigure remote
reconfigure_lutron.description: Rename this remote, or pick a different Pico if you replaced it. Every button keeps its actions.

error.already_configured: One of these event entities is already used by another button.
error.not_blueprint: This automation doesn't use the Lutron Pico Universal Actions blueprint.
error.invalid_action: One of the actions is invalid. Check the logs for details.
error.pico_in_use: This Pico already drives another remote, so every press would run twice.
error.not_a_pico: This device doesn't have Pico buttons Button Actions can use.
error.buttons_missing: This Pico doesn't have every button this remote uses. Missing: {missing}.

init.title: Click timing
init.description: These apply to every button on this remote. Use the edit button next to a button to change what it does.

data_description.double_ms: How long to wait for a second press. Only applies to buttons with a double-press action.
data_description.hold_ms: How long a button must be held to count as a long press.
data_description.repeat_ms: How often the long-press action repeats while held, for buttons with repeat turned on.

user.title: Add button
user.description: Choose which button to add. For remotes that use event entities, also pick the event entities it reports through.

data_description.entities: The event entities this button reports through. Pick several to have multiple remotes share these actions.

actions.title: {button}
actions.description: Choose what each gesture does. Actions use the same editor as scripts and automations, so any action, target and data works.

data_description.short_press: Runs on release. Fires instantly unless a double-press action is set, in which case it waits briefly for a second press.
data_description.double_press: Runs on the second press. Leave empty to keep short presses instant.
data_description.long_press: Runs once the button has been held for the hold time.
data_description.long_release: Runs when a held button is let go, for example to stop a cover.
data_description.repeat: Keep re-running the long-press action while the button is held, for hold-to-dim or hold-to-raise volume.
